# Editing a PR body with `gh api -X PATCH` gets the "Generated by" footer added back
- where: `docs/backlog/prompts/executor.md` (steps 1.11 and section 2: PR body written with `gh api ... -F body=@/tmp/pr.md`)
- why it matters: in the cloud session the footer reappears after a `gh api` PATCH, so a fix round that only reads its own file claims it is gone; it cost three review rounds (WR-001 r1, WR-002 r1, WR-002 r2). Updating the body through the GitHub MCP `update_pull_request` tool left it clean; the prompt could name that route and require re-reading the body
- found by: WR-002, reviewer and executor, 2026-11-25
